verdict.rationale: Stripe's API versioning page documents monthly releases that can be adopted without code changes. Terminal SDK migration guides for major versions 5.0.0 and 6.0.0 show versioned releases with upgrade paths. However, no item states a deprecation policy, such as timelines, sunset notices or support windows for old versions. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented deprecation policy and timeline, details on version pinning and support windows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: You can safely upgrade to any monthly release without updating your code.
